title: Autobattler
author: Less-Quit5896
selftext:
This is the first project Ive taken far enough that I’d consider the core loop basically intact.

It’s an auto battler with a few things to do inside battles. This demo takes about 7 mins to complete.

Built with Claude mainly with project chat. 

Learned alot during the process, developed a harness / headless system which simulated 100s battles to try and balance on data.... that said balancing it has definitely been the hardest part.

https://vinrex.itch.io/pocket-heroes-v-war-and-ale

comments.author: burnerburnee
comments.body: Interesting. Loaded it up while waiting for Claude at work. I guess the limited movement and days is meant to be a scoring mechanism at the end? I didn't find any real need for it and it just made the game slower. Unless for a high score you're trying to get the player to weigh if they should go back to camp? Also, the "arm" button to upgrade a troop didn't seem to describe what I was doing. Overall I like it.

replies.author: Less-Quit5896
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. Yeah that was the idea, something like the old homm or kingsbounty games where days where a factor in end score. With the arm button the original idea was to upgrade troops instead of doing that individually less micro but now i can see the complexity increase as i add more classes and weapon choice so maybe ill remove it or rework it

replies.author: burnerburnee
replies.body: The idea of running the game as a simulation to calculate balance is super interesting. Did you shoot for a lose rate? Simulate all possible player choices to see how bad you had to play to lose?

replies.author: Less-Quit5896
replies.body:
I agree, ive been using it with party comp and cooldowns.. there's probably a better way to do this but learning as i go
